description: Guardian agent: flags extreme volume-to-liquidity turnover, symmetric buy/sell churn, micro-trade spam, thin liquidity and volume from a handful of trades. Returns a 0-100 wash score. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
